meta.name: ai-video-generation
meta.description: Generate AI videos with Google Veo, Seedance 2.0, HappyHorse, Wan, Grok and 40+ models via inference.sh CLI. Models: Veo 3.1, Veo 3, Seedance 2.0, HappyHorse 1.0, Wan 2.5, Grok Imagine Video, OmniHuman, Fabric, HunyuanVideo. Capabilities: text-to-video, image-to-video, reference-to-video, video editing, lipsync, avatar animation, video upscaling, foley sound. Use for: social media videos, marketing content, explainer videos, product demos, AI avatars. Triggers: video generation, ai video, text to video, image to video, veo, animate image, video from image, ai animation, video generator, generate video, t2v, i2v, ai video maker, create video with ai, runway alternative, pika alternative, sora alternative, kling alternative, seedance, happyhorse

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用40多种AI模型生成和编辑视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速生成AI视频用于社交媒体或营销。
copy.tagline_en: Generate and edit videos with 40+ AI models
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly create AI videos for social media or marketing.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能通过命令行调用 40 多种 AI 模型生成视频，支持文生视频、图生视频、视频编辑、口型同步、虚拟人动画、视频增强和添加音效。
howto.when: 当用户提出生成视频、AI 视频、文生视频、图生视频等关键词，或要求使用 Veo、Seedance、HappyHorse 等模型时触发。

say.text: 用 Veo 生成一段无人机飞越森林的视频。
把这张图片变成动画，用 Wan 2.5。
say.note: Claude 会使用 Wan 2.5 模型将图片转为视频。

say.text: 给这段视频加上脚步声和鸟鸣的音效。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can generate videos using 40+ AI models via command line, supporting text-to-video, image-to-video, video editing, lipsync, avatar animation, upscaling, and foley sound.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user mentions video generation, AI video, text-to-video, image-to-video, or specific model names like Veo, Seedance, HappyHorse, etc.
